name: Ranger: A Quick Demise extends ranked Serrated Shot auras (#2019)
contract: A Quick Demise 560810 (ProcChance 20) triggers 561109, whose single effect 177 SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_AURA_DURATION carries MiscValue 500073 (Serrated Shot) with +2000 ms. Serrated Shot has seven DBC records chained in spell_ranks (500073 rank 1 through 575837 rank 7, SpellLevel 16-62), but Spell::EffectAscensionModifyAuraDuration resolved the aura with an exact spell-id lookup, so only rank 1 was ever extended and every Ranger above level 24 saw nothing. The handler now resolves with Unit::GetAuraOfRankedSpell, which walks the chain from the first rank; behavior is identical when the rank-1 aura is present and previously-dead lookups come alive. All four scripted effect-177 users (Witch Hunter flames, Venomancer mycosis, Reaper deathchaser, Felsworn inner demon) PreventHitDefaultEffect, so the shared default path change cannot reach them. The scenario applies the rank-7 aura (575837, the rank a level-80 Ranger owns) to a dummy, snapshots its remaining duration, casts 561109 directly (costless, enemy-targeted, no gates), and asserts a +2000 ms delta: before the fix the delta is never positive. Serrated Shot needs a bow or crossbow (mask bits 2/18), Advantage 804329 and 25 Focus, all fixtured; every cast asserts cast_failure 0 so a broken fixture fails as setup.
